p.src: Overview: The Poisson bracket is more than a compact way to rewrite Hamilton’s equations. It is an algebraic operation that generates transformations. Bracketing with the Hamiltonian generates time evolution; bracketing with momentum generates translations; bracketing with angular momentum generates rotations. In this language, symmetry and conservation become the two readings of one vanishing bracket. We shall develop that idea from the harmonic oscillator and then use the angular-momentum algebra to obtain gyroscopic precession without introducing Euler angles.

ja: 概観: ポアソン括弧は、ハミルトンの方程式を書き直すための簡潔な方法以上のものである。それは変換を生成する代数的操作である。ハミルトニアンとの括弧は時間発展を生成し、運動量との括弧は並進を生成し、角運動量との括弧は回転を生成する。この言葉遣いでは、対称性と保存則は、一つの消える括弧の二つの読み方になる。この考えを調和振動子から展開し、次に角運動量代数を用いて、オイラー角を導入することなくジャイロスコープの歳差運動を得る。
zh: 概述: 泊松括号不仅仅是一种紧凑地改写哈密顿方程的方式。它是一种生成变换的代数运算。与哈密顿量作括号运算生成时间演化；与动量作括号运算生成平移；与角动量作括号运算生成旋转。在这种语言中，对称性与守恒成为同一个消失的括号的两种解读。我们将从谐振子出发发展这一思想，然后利用角动量代数在不引入欧拉角的情况下得到陀螺进动。

p.src:
The bracket can now be used as a calculus of its own. Its rules follow from ordinary differentiation: $\begin{aligned}\{A,B\}&=-\{B,A\}, \\
  \{A+B,C\}&=\{A,C\}+\{B,C\}, \\
  \{\lambda A,B\}&=\lambda\{A,B\},
    \quad \lambda\ \text{constant}, \\
  \{AB,C\}&=A\{B,C\}+\{A,C\}B. \end{aligned}$ These four lines express antisymmetry, additivity, linearity under multiplication by a constant, and the Leibniz rule, respectively. Classical phase-space functions multiply commutatively, so the placement of the ordinary factors $A$ and $B$ in the last line is immaterial. That will no longer be true for operators in quantum mechanics. Antisymmetry also implies $\{A,A\}=0.$

For canonical coordinates the elementary brackets are $\boxed{
  \{q_i,q_j\}=0,\qquad
  \{p_i,p_j\}=0,\qquad
  \{q_i,p_j\}=\delta_{ij}.}$ Any function only of the $q_i$ has zero bracket with any other function only of the $q_i$; the analogous statement holds for functions only of the $p_i$. A nonzero bracket requires a canonical coordinate to meet its conjugate momentum. The Kronecker delta in Eq. [eq:l8-canonical-brackets] records that only matching indices meet.

p.src:
Consider $H=\frac{p^2}{2m}+\frac{kq^2}{2}.$ We now deliberately use only the bracket rules and Eq. [eq:l8-time-generator]. First, $\begin{aligned}\dot q
  &=\{q,H\}\\
  &=\frac{1}{2m}\{q,p^2\}\\
  &=\frac{1}{2m}\left(p\{q,p\}+\{q,p\}p\right)\\
  &=\frac{p}{m}.
  \end{aligned}$ The potential term disappears because $\{q,q^2\}=0$. Similarly, $\begin{aligned}\dot p
  &=\{p,H\}\\
  &=\frac{k}{2}\{p,q^2\}\\
  &=\frac{k}{2}\left(q\{p,q\}+\{p,q\}q\right)\\
  &=-kq.
  \end{aligned}$ The minus sign is precisely the antisymmetry $\{p,q\}=-\{q,p\}=-1$. Combining the two first-order equations gives $m\ddot q=-kq.$

p.src: Response: Yes. The distinction is mostly geometric language: when the spinning axis extends sideways from its support one usually says gyroscope; when it is nearly vertical one says top. The angular-momentum and torque structure is the same.

u.src: Response: Yes. The distinction is mostly geometric language: when the spinning axis extends sideways from its support one usually says gyroscope; when it is nearly vertical one says top. The angular-momentum and torque structure is the same.
en: Response: Yes. The distinction is mostly geometric language: when the spinning axis extends sideways from its support one usually says gyroscope; when it is nearly vertical one says top. The angular-momentum and torque structure is the same.
ja: 回答: はい。区別は主に幾何学的な言葉遣いである。回転軸が支持体から横向きに伸びているときは通常ジャイロスコープと言い、ほぼ鉛直であるときは独楽と言う。角運動量とトルクの構造は同じである。
zh: 回答: 是的。区别主要在于几何用语：当自转轴从支座向侧方伸出时，通常称之为陀螺仪；当它接近竖直时，则称之为陀螺。角动量和力矩的结构是相同的。
